site.title: C2Coder Photo

hero.headline: Event photos with context and atmosphere.
body: I photograph events that deserve to be captured as a whole, not just as a single frame. I care about how an image works together with the text, the order of the photos, and the story it tells.
I do not want galleries that are only pretty pictures without context. I like choosing images so the flow, mood, and reason for the day stay clear.

highlights.title: Events
highlights.text: Workshops, public events, and real moments where story and pacing matter.

highlights.title: Series
highlights.text: More than a single photo; I prefer a compact report or a themed selection.

highlights.title: Editing
highlights.text: Clean crops, color, and photo order that keep attention moving.

portfolio.title: Selected work
portfolio.intro: Each entry is its own selection or event. Click it to open the full-size images.

about.title: About
about.intro: I shoot in a way that makes the result useful for sharing, archiving, and remembering the atmosphere later on.

about: I am a student from the Czech Republic and photography is a companion to my work with electronics and code - same approach: understand the process end to end.
I prefer shooting events and workshops where the process and the people around it are visible, not just the final frame.
I keep editing simple - clean crops, consistent color, and a selection that reads as a whole, not just individual photos.
site.contactLead: If you want photos, collaboration, or just want to yell at me how wrongly i did something, write me.
